title: Deploy-safety validator for Private Cloud IaC with staged plan gates
creator: Maya Chen
description: Implement a deploy-safety validator that runs in the Terraform CI pipeline for Private (VPC) deployments. The validator will perform staged plan checks, cost and surface-change heuristics, policy-as-code assertions (OPA + Conftest adapter prototype), and a light runtime health lint that flags risky upgrade operations. The goal is to block or label PRs with actionable remediation and produce a machine-readable plan-score for downstream automation (canary rollouts, automatic rollback thresholds).
proposed_solution: Add a new pipeline step 'deploy-safety-validator' that: (1) runs terraform fmt/validate + tflint + custom rulepack; (2) generates a detailed plan JSON and calculates plan-score (resource churn, port exposure, KMS/key changes, IAM wide grants, disk resizing, net changes); (3) executes policy-as-code checks via an OPA/Conftest adapter and returns structured failures; (4) posts results to PR and to a 'preflight' dashboard; (5) if plan-score > threshold or critical policy fails, mark job as failed and add remediation snippets. Provide a lightweight drift probe and a post-apply health-check playbook for reserved deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Pipeline step runs on all private-vpc terraform PRs and fails/blocks when critical policy violations are detected
Plan-score is computed and stored as a numeric annotation on the PR and visible in preflight dashboard
Conftest/OPA adapter supports at least 12 baseline rules (iam, network, kms, public_s3, egress)
PR comment includes actionable remediation and links to relevant docs/PRs/Runbooks
Automated canary gating integration demo working with one Dedicated cluster within release window
